sources.title: ಸರ್ವಜ್ಞ ವಚನಗಳು
sources.rights_notes: Official Indian Copyright Office materials state that published literary works generally receive life-of-author + 60 years. Scholarly sources identify Uttangi as editor of the 1924 edition and state he died in 1962. This makes expiry in India a strong candidate conclusion, but the project must verify the rights chain, edition status, any government ownership/assignment, and jurisdiction before treating this edition as unrestricted.
sources.reliability_notes: Bibliographic evidence is strong; exact 1924 scan/page text not yet located.
